name: Roc Monus
source:
Roc Avari is the King of Monus. Roc believes that a king should have no weaknesses. He also seems to still favor his first wife Min over his second wife Rahm even after her death.

[From [url=https://court-of-darkness.fandom.com/wiki/Roc_Avari]Fandom Wiki[/url]]
